name: assistant.avado.dnp.dappnode.eth
title: Private Assistant
description:
Your own AI chat assistant, running entirely on your AVADO. Ask questions, get help with writing, or let it read a document for you. Your chats and files stay on your box: nothing is sent to an AI company.

On first start it picks a model that suits your box's memory and downloads it. Models are big (about 2.5 GB on a 32 GB box, about 19 GB on a 64 GB box), so with normal home internet this takes from a few minutes to about an hour. The page shows how far it is.

Be aware: the assistant does not use a graphics chip (no AVADO box can use one for AI yet), so it runs on the processor and is slower than ChatGPT. Answers appear word by word at a steady pace, not instantly, and the first answer after a pause takes longer while the model loads. After the download the page measures how fast it is on your box. Your Ethereum node always comes first: it gets the processor before the assistant, and if memory ever runs short the assistant is stopped, not the node.

The assistant is protected by your own account: the first account you create becomes the owner, and nobody else can make an account unless you add them. It can make mistakes, so check important answers.
shortDescription: Your own AI chat assistant, private on your box
